Michael Huffman
Robin // Menlo Park
We are thrilled to be part of the dynamic restaurant lineup at Springline. Bringing our contemporary local omakase concept to Silicon Valley and the Springline community has been a wonderful and rewarding experience.
Dana Bloom
Co-CEO // Proper Food
We’re thrilled to bring Proper Food to Springline! At Proper Food, we believe you shouldn’t have to choose between eating well and eating fast. Our fresh, made-from-scratch meals - crafted daily from the best local ingredients - fit perfectly with Springline’s vibrant, forward-thinking community. Whether you’re grabbing a quick, nourishing bite between meetings or enjoying a wholesome meal on the go, we’re here to make healthy eating effortless. Plus, with our commitment to donating unsold food each day, we’re proud to contribute to a more sustainable and connected community.
David Nayfeld
Chef & Partner // Che Fico
I chose to open a restaurant in Springline because Presidio Bay’s commitment to building community deeply aligns with my values. The development itself is stunning, thoughtfully designed, and incredibly well-appointed, creating an environment that inspires connection and a sense of belonging. It’s the perfect setting for a restaurant where people can gather, share meals, and create lasting memories.
Parking Options
We've got your spot.
Coming for coffee? Working for the day? Meeting friends for dinner? Charging up? 
We've got you covered.
Public Parking
Hours:
 Open daily from 7:00 AM – 12:00 AM. 
Entry/Exit:
 Enter via El Camino Real or Garwood Way. 
Parking:
 Not assigned; park in any available space. 
Rates:
 First 2 hours are free, then $3 per hour, with a $20 daily max and $20 overnight fee. Validation available when dining at a restaurant on property. 
Ticket:
 Keep your ticket; lost tickets cost $20. 
Duration:
 Public parking limited to 72 hours unless pre-arranged. 
Wayfinding Guide:
Shops on Oak Grove:
 Access via yellow/grey elevators 
Shops on El Camino Real:
 Access via red elevators 
North Office (1302):
 Access via blue elevators 
South Office (1300):
 Access via green elevators 
Plaza Staircase:
 From the Garage Level look for the Black and Grey decals pointing to the stairwell access. From the Plaza Level access via metal gate. 
Office and Restaurant Tenant Parking
Entry/Exit: Enter via El Camino Real or Garwood Way. Please direct your guests and visitors to do the same. 
Parking: Not assigned; park in any available space. 
Rates: Monthly permits are available for employees of office and restaurant tenants, providing 24/7 access to the garage. Contact Building Management to purchase a monthly permit. 
Resident Parking
Entry/Exit: Enter via El Camino Real or Garwood Way. Please direct your guests and visitors to do the same. 
Parking: Not assigned; park in any available space. 
Rates: Monthly permits are available for residents, providing 24/7 access to the garage. Contact Building Management for monthly permit arrangements. 
Prospective Resident Parking
Validated parking is available in the garage for prospective residents. Present your parking ticket at the leasing office for validation at the time of your visit.
EV Charging Stations
Charging stations are available on a first-come, first-served basis. Please move your vehicle once charging is complete to allow others to use the station.
